data_fields.name: creature_attack_roll
data_fields.donor_constant: rand(16) + attack + 2 x difficulty - 2 x parry

data_fields.name: wound_area_table_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: 7 in 8 use the probability table, 1 in 8 hand wound (woundTest & 0x0070)

data_fields.name: stat_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: 170 - stat; below 16 gives attack >> 3, else attack x factor >> 7

best_idea: Sum every hit a target takes in a tick into one pending ledger, decide the kill once at the end of the pass, and scale raw attack by a defence multiplier rather than subtracting it.
decision_why: Adopt the pending-ledger apply pass and the defence-multiplier shape (fits one ledger and server-verified kills); reject per-body-part wound flags (wounds are cosmetic, row 8) and the normal-type bypass that skips armour, since our one damage path should have no silent exemption.
acceptance: A server test lands two creature swings on one champion inside one tick; health drops once at the end of the tick by the sum, the kill is decided at that apply, and the client shows one damage number for that champion for the tick.
